privatePostView.description: View of one private-tier post (tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate) that the requester is authorized to read. Carries no counts: a reply count would disclose replies the viewer cannot see.

record.description: The decoded private record, with $type 'tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate'. Carries text, createdAt, audienceList (at-uri) and, for replies, reply ({root, parent} strong refs). Encoded-content fields are never emitted.

labels.description: Labels on the post. Empty in v1.

privateThreadView.description: A node in a private thread. Parents and replies the requester cannot see are omitted without distinction.

parent.description: The parent post: a private post, or a public post when a private reply's parent is public. Absent at the thread root and where the parent chain stops at a missed parent.

replies.description: Authorized private replies to this post, ordered by createdAt ascending, at most 50 per node.

publicParent.description: A public post that is the parent of a private reply.
